info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Transportation and Logistics
info.sub_ename: SPECIAL TOPICS ON INTELLIGENT TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM

description.sub_ename: SPECIAL TOPICS ON INTELLIGENT TRANSPORTATION SYSTEM
description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹各種智慧運輸系統的發展現況與智慧物流之應用，培養學生能運用有效運輸管理策略解決運輸實務中的問題。本課程進一步探討人工智慧在物流運輸系統領域的使用，使學生能夠通過學習物聯網（IoT），大數據，雲計算等互聯網技術來了解AIOT的當前發展。建立新的物流服務模式和未來發展趨勢。
description.describe_eh: This course introduces development situations of various intelligent transportation and the application of smart logistics. The students can apply effective transportation management strategies to solve practical transportation problems. This course also explores the current use of artificial intelligence technology in the field of logistics system, enabling students to understand the current development of AIOT through the application of internet technologies such as Internet of Things (IoT), big data, cloud computing, and how to build new logistics service model and future development trends.

targets.describe_ch: 7. 培養學生評析與討論國內外運輸或物流時勢議題之能力。
targets.describe_en: 7. Develop students' ability to analyze and discuss domestic and international current issues in transportation and logistics.

targets.describe_ch: 10. 培養學生撰寫研究論文或技術報告、相互研討、製作簡報及口頭報告之能力。
targets.describe_en: 10. Develop students' ability to write research papers or technical reports, engage in academic discussions, design presentations, and deliver oral presentations.

gradeRules.evalb_memo: Active participation in discussions, sharing personal views and opinions, as well as completing assignments after class.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. In this course, students are prohibited from behaviors such as talking loudly, playing games, or chatting online during class. If a student repeats these behaviors after three warnings, they may be asked to leave the classroom, depending on the situation.

2. In this course, students are not allowed to disrupt the learning of others in any form during class, whether in-person or online.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1. This course prohibits students from engaging in the following behaviors: making noise in class, playing games, chatting via the Internet, etc. If the student still commits the same action after 3 reminders, the student will be asked to leave the classroom according to the situation.
2. This course prohibits students from interfering with the learning of other students in any form in the classroom (including offline or online).
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
1. There are numerous appropriate online learning resources available for this course. Please engage in self-directed learning to avoid falling behind in the course progress.
2. Active participation and learning are expected in this course. Volunteering to solve problems on the board, responding to questions, organizing notes, and engaging in discussions with the instructor will all contribute positively to your final grade.
3. There are plenty of learning resources available for this course. Students are encouraged to proactively seek out and utilize these resources.
4. Consistently completing assignments will undoubtedly be beneficial.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en:
1. This course expects students to actively learn and participate. All kinds of active learning such as answering exercises, responding to questions, organizing notes, and discussing with teachers and students will contribute to the final grade.
2. This course has quite a lot of learning resources, and students are encouraged to actively search and learn.
3. Doing exercises frequently will definitely help.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
• Assignments and reports in this course are used to evaluate students' learning outcomes. Students are encouraged to do their best in completing them and are expected to engage in peer learning and discussions. However, plagiarism or violations of academic integrity are strictly prohibited.
  • If a student is found to have clearly engaged in plagiarism or violated academic integrity in any assignments, reports, or exams, they will not receive a passing grade for the course.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
1. The assignments and reports of this course are used to evaluate students' learning. Students are encouraged to do their best to complete them all, and students are expected to learn from and discuss with each other, however, no plagiarism or violation of academic ethics is allowed.
2. If a student significantly plagiarizes or violates academic ethics in the assignments, reports, or exams of this course, the final grade of the course will not be passed.
